_comment: AoA night rebalance: Rotten Creatures EVEN overworld baseline -- generic undead present everywhere at a uniform weight. Rotten Creatures ships NO natural spawns of its own, so this datapack is the sole source. The biome-themed rotten (frostbitten/glacial_hunter -> snowy, swampy -> swamp, mummy -> desert/badlands, dead_beard -> beach) stack on top in their own biomes.
